Phase 1 of the Unification Drop claim has now ended. Addresses that were eligible in Phase 1 can no longer claim. More details on Phase 2 will be released very soon.
Today rollups are sowing the seeds for the next evolution of blockchain technology, bringing with them a new wave of challenges that need to be resolved. Due to the efforts of pioneers from all corners of the ecosystem and Avail’s highly vetted team, a comprehensive solution to rollup security, scalability and interoperability is possible, unlocking a new phase for blockchain technology.
To express gratitude to those who have laid a solid foundation for the entire ecosystem, as well as those who have helped Avail get to where it is today,
Avail is announcing the Unification Drop with a 600 Million AVAIL allocation!
The Unification Drop is a unifying force bringing different communities together, rewarding developers, governance contributors, technical educators, rollup users, stakers and other valuable contributors from across multiple blockchain communities.
Please note:
claim.availproject.org
is the only way to access the Avail Claims Portal. Please make sure this is the
only URL
you are using to access the claims portal. Be aware of phishing attempts and unofficial links. Only follow links that are hosted on the
availproject.org
domain.
What is Avail?
Technical constraints have made it hard for different ecosystems to cross-pollinate and leverage each other’s core strengths. Advancements in one ecosystem don’t always translate to advancements in the other, however with Avail’s unification layer this becomes possible.
Since 2020, Avail has been developing an unprecedented solution to
the data availability problem
, resolving inescapable challenges facing rollup scalability.
Avail DA
scales rollups exponentially using
KZG commitments
and
Data Availability Sampling
, implementing the same solutions earmarked for Ethereum’s Danksharding roadmap. However, addressing rollup scalability necessitates the question of how rollups will interoperate.
Leveraging the unique characteristics of Avail DA,
Avail Nexus
provides a permissionless coordination hub where cross-chain complexity gets abstracted away from end users, giving developers the ability to offer bridgeless cross-chain experiences to their users. With Nexus, comprehensive multi-step transactions can be achieved with a smooth user experience.
Importantly, the unification layer must be extremely secure.
Avail Fusion
extends re-staking to incorporate multiple assets such as ETH, BTC and others, to provide strong, unified security.
The Avail utility token, '
AVAIL
' is the native utility token of the Avail Network, powering Avail DA, Nexus and Fusion and the
unification of web3
. It’s used to obtain Avail DA services, secure the unification layer via staking and take part in governance.
Eligibility Overview - Avail’s Unification Drop
Avail is providing innovative core rollup infrastructure for the whole community to utilize. Avail began inside Polygon Labs and later became a fully-fledged, independent entity, led by former Polygon co-founder
Anurag Arjun
and research lead
Prabal Banerjee
. When deciding on the eligibility criteria for the Unification Drop, we wanted to reward those who are making valuable contributions to the ecosystem, and take building core blockchain infrastructure as seriously as we do. In doing so, a lot of effort has gone into making sure the airdrop reflected these core values:
High Impact
- How much of an impact have these contributions made to the blockchain community?
High Quality
- How have these efforts contributed positively towards the ecosystem’s development?
High Engagement
- How much time has gone into developing these ecosystems and communities?
Additionally, Sybil detection methodologies have been implemented to identify and prevent exploitation, where one actor operates multiple wallets with help from
OpenBlock Labs
.
A total of 354,605 wallet addresses are eligible to receive AVAIL when Avail DA launches on Mainnet soon; this does not include the 10,000 wallets eligible for an
Avail OG NFT
.
Eligible Categories for the Unification Drop
Blockchain Ecosystem Developers
Incentivised Testnet Contributors
Rollup Users
Polygon PoS Stakers
Significant Community Contributors
You can verify your claim from today until the cut-off date, 11:59pm GMT 4th May 2024. Please note, you need to verify your AVAIL claim by going to
claim.availproject.org
and following the claims process. AVAIL will be allocated when Avail DA launches on mainnet. You can verify for each category you are eligible.
Please see below for more details on how these categories were selected and the eligibility criteria for each.
Blockchain Ecosystem Developers
Developers across the entire blockchain ecosystem have been working for years to build and scale public blockchains to improve the decentralized coordination of people all around the world. If it weren’t for the contributions made by developers who have helped push the technology forward, the pioneering work from the Avail Team that pushes things even further, wouldn’t have been possible.
Unification of web3 requires unification to happen at the most fundamental level. This includes
Bitcoin
,
Ethereum
,
Solana
,
Cosmos
,
Avalanche
,
Near
and others who have each made unique contributions to the  blockchain ecosystem.
As a show of thanks to the thousands of Blockchain Ecosystem Developers who have contributed significant work, AVAIL has been made available to eligible addresses of Github accounts that contributed to the public repos of projects in the graphic below. See the
full list here
.
Note - Blockchain Ecosystem Developers will need to connect a Github and Avail account to the Claims Portal. Follow this tutorial to
set up an Avail Account
.
Incentivised Testnet Contributors
Avail has been strengthened through intensive testing and Clash of Nodes provided the perfect battleground for this. Over 87,000 accounts contributed to the Goldberg Testnet which processed more than 118 million transactions.
During the testing phase alone, Avail DA facilitated enough data submissions to
satisfy the demands of almost all the L2s in 2023
(140 GB)
.
When it comes to mainnet, performance and reliability are key to providing the best infra possible. To reward those running the most reliable infrastructure, building high performing rollups and submitting copious amounts of data to Avail DA, AVAIL has been allocated to eligible addresses. Clash of Nodes participants can verify their claims now based on their position on the
leaderboard
.
Light Client Lift-off participants also put Avail’s
Light Client Network
to the test with almost 1 million total light clients during the challenge period. 50,000 of the top performing light client operators have been randomly selected for AVAIL rewards. Gold, Silver and Bronze
Avail OG NFTs
have also been allocated to an additional 10,000 top performing Light Client operators, weighted by uptime, and will be foundational in establishing the NFT community on Avail.
Individuals operating rollups on the incentivized testnet in the Dymension and Madara ecosystems are eligible to claim rewards. Thousands of developers created rollups in these ecosystems, and earned points on the Clash of Nodes leaderboards. If you created a Dymension RollApp or Madara app chain, be sure to check eligibility.
Rollup Users
Rollups are an incredible scaling unlock for the entire ecosystem, however without active users, these rollups would not have been able to show the impact they can have to the world.
Avail is pushing the boundaries in rollup infrastructure, with a focus on solving core technical challenges facing rollup scalability, interoperability and security. With the future of blockchain technology converging on rollups as a solution to blockchain scalability challenges, we wanted to express gratitude to the most pioneering rollup users shaping the future of blockchain technology.
For this category, we have focussed on leading rollups that have made unique contributions to the open source community. To show our gratitude to the users who helped make the rollup ecosystem what it is today, AVAIL has been made available to eligible wallets on
Arbitrum One
,
OP Mainnet
,
Polygon zkEVM
,
Starknet
and
zkSync era
.
Extensive efforts have gone into identifying and excluding Sybil and Sybil-connected wallets with the help of OpenBlock Labs. This included activities such as analyzing first funding transactions, asset transfer graphs, community detection algorithms, the identification of Sybil structures and statistical analysis of wallet groups within communities. The snapshot was taken on March 31, 2024.
Polygon PoS Stakers
Polygon played a very important role in the early days of Avail’s inception. Avail began inside Polygon Labs in 2020 and later became an independent entity, led by former Polygon co-founder
Anurag Arjun
and research lead
Prabal Banerjee
. Avail is thrilled to now be contributing back to the ecosystem that helped kick start Avail with the Unification Drop by rewarding Polygon PoS stakers. A snapshot was taken March 31, 2024.
Significant Community Contributors
A lot of important contributors can sometimes go by unnoticed. If it weren’t for those participating in governance to help shape the future direction of key protocols, or the ones who monitor and educate others about key developments in core technologies, the ecosystem wouldn’t be where it is today. Those who help to resolve community queries and distill knowledge for others within the Avail community also play a vital role.
To reward those helping shape the future of decentralized governance, rewards have been allocated to various contributors including prominent academic institutions and individual contributors. The recognition of active governance contributors is a pivotal step towards fostering collaboration, innovation, and community growth within the blockchain ecosystem. By leveraging data-driven methodologies and inclusive selection criteria, we aim to empower and incentivize continued participation in governance processes, thereby driving positive impact and progress across decentralized networks.
Phase 2
Phase 2 of the Unification Drop is now under way, extending claims for the Unification Drop. You can verify your claim for Phase 2 from today until the cut-off date. The cut-off date
12th May 2024
,
16:00 UTC
has been extended to
15th May 2024
,
16:00 UTC.
To see if you’re eligible for Phase 2, head to
claim.availproject.org
Eligible Categories for Phase 2
Clash of Nodes Participants
Liquid Staking Protocol Users for Polygon PoS
Blockchain Ecosystem Developers
Clash of Nodes Participants
Clash of Nodes participants played a vital role in battle testing the Avail network and
as promised
, an increased number of Clash of Nodes participants are now eligible to verify their claim in Phase 2 of Avail’s Unification Drop!
A massive 37k+ more Clash of Nodes participants are eligible to verify their claim for Phase 2, including the Circuit Breaker hackathon winners that received Clash of Nodes points and many of the participants that placed on the Clash of Nodes leaderboard. To verify your claim, go to the claims portal now.
The amount of AVAIL allocated to Clash of Nodes participants in Phase 1 has also been increased. No action is required for these accounts and AVAIL tokens claimed during Phase 1 will be distributed shortly. In total, 60 Million AVAIL has now been allocated to Clash of Nodes participants, and 89.5 Million AVAIL to the ​​Incentivised Testnet Contributors category overall.
Liquid Staking Protocol Users for Polygon PoS
Polygon has played an important role in Avail’s inception. Using the same qualifying criteria as Phase 1, we’re now also rewarding some LST holders for Phase 2.
6.9 Million AVAIL has been allocated to eligible addresses of 12k+ liquid staking protocol users from the following providers:
Lido
Stader
Tenderize
Claystack
TruFin
Blockchain Ecosystem Developers
Additionally, 18 Github repos are now included in Phase 2. See the
list of eligible Github repos
for Phase 2.
Future Activities
This is just the beginning. The Unification Points Program will reward the community for their contribution, education, and participation with Avail and the broader rollup community. The program will incentivize apps or rollups that support the Avail ecosystem, and more.
If you weren’t eligible today - join us on
X
,
Discord
and
Telegram
to stay informed for upcoming programs coming soon.
Verify your AVAIL claim now!
To check your eligibility, review the
Mainnet Terms & Conditions
and the
Supplemental Airdrop Terms & Conditions
and verify your claim for AVAIL Tokens by going to
claim.availproject.org
. If you’re not sure how to claim, check the
Avail Unification Drop Claims Tutorial
. You’ll also need to
set up an Avail account
if you haven’t already.
Please note that not all addresses are eligible for the claim, see the eligibility criteria and exclusions above. However, if you believe you are eligible for the claim and you are having trouble with the claims portal, you can submit a query via the feedback form here (form is no longer active).
AVAIL will be airdropped when Avail DA Mainnet launches to qualifying addresses that successfully complete their claim verification, before the cut-off date.
We’d like to thank
the team
at
OpenBlock
Labs, a data intelligence platform, for their contribution to data analysis and extraction.
